results: V13 already closes arbitrary finite multiplicative products and quotients of division-polynomial quadratic characters on secp256k1, so bounded multi-decimation search is no longer the primary secp256k1 frontier
for s_i=sigma(alpha^i(Q)), carry c=s_0*s_1*s_2 and sector bits kappa_0=s_1*s_2, kappa_1=s_2*s_0, kappa_2=s_0*s_1, canonical parity factors as sigma(Q)=c*kappa_0
kappa_0*kappa_1*kappa_2=1, so the sector state is a Klein-four state
the V14 selector is the C3 Fourier transform u=-(kappa_0+beta^2*kappa_1+beta*kappa_2)
h(u)=(u^3+u^2-2u+6)/6 recovers kappa_0 and its two GLV rotations recover kappa_1 and kappa_2
the V14 invariant mode collapses to A/y=c*(1+u^3/6), so A/y is not a third independent orientation observable
the x-only Kummer involution J_G(x)=Y_G(beta*x)Y_G(beta^2*x)/(x^3+7) equals kappa_0 on the marked subgroup
J_G(x)^2=1 and J_G(x)J_G(beta*x)J_G(beta^2*x)=1 on the half-kernel
